<|user|>Make an animation of gray twinkling stars on a canvas, not too many<|end|><|assistant|><!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Particles</title>
<style>
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: #f5f5f7;
  color: #1f2937;
}
canvas {
  background: #05060f;
  border-radius: 8px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="400" height="300"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const particles = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
  particles.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, r: 0.5 + Math.random() * 2, t: Math.random() * 6.28 });
}
function loop() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const p of particles) {
    p.t += 0.05;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(p.t);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
<|end|>

<|user|>Can you make a Pong game where I move the red paddle on the left with the arrow keys, the computer plays the green paddle, and the score counts my hits on a dark background<|end|><|assistant|><!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Pong</title>
<style>
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: #111827;
  color: #f9fafb;
}
canvas {
  border-radius: 8px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="320"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 4, vy: 3, r: 8 };
let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;
});
document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});
function reset() {
  ball.x = W / 2;
  ball.y = H / 2;
  ball.vx = 4 * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
  ball.vy = 3;
}
function loop() {
  if (up) player.y -= 5;
  if (down) player.y += 5;
  player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - player.h, player.y));
  ai.y += (ball.y - (ai.y + ai.h / 2)) * 0.06;
  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;
  if (ball.y < ball.r || ball.y > H - ball.r) ball.vy *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 24 && ball.y > player.y && ball.y < player.y + player.h && ball.vx < 0) {
    ball.vx *= -1.05;
    score++;
  }
  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#dc2626";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#16a34a";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
<|end|>

const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 4, vy: 3, r: 8 };

let down = false;

  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;

  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});

    ball.vx *= -1.05;
    score++;
  }
  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4f46e5";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };

  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9333ea";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();

let down = false;

  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;

});

  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();

  if (ball.x > W) reset();

  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);

  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);

}

}

<canvas id="c" width="480" height="320"></canvas>

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");

const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 4, vy: 3, r: 8 };
let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;
});
document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});
function reset() {
  ball.x = W / 2;
  ball.y = H / 2;
  ball.vx = 4 * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
  ball.vy = 3;
}

  if (up) player.y -= 5;
  if (down) player.y += 5;
  player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - player.h, player.y));

  ball.y += ball.vy;
  if (ball.y < ball.r || ball.y > H - ball.r) ball.vy *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 24 && ball.y > player.y && ball.y < player.y + player.h && ball.vx < 0) {
    ball.vx *= -1.05;
    score++;
  }
  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9333ea";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>

  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

body {

<canvas id="c" width="480" height="320"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 4, vy: 3, r: 8 };
let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;
});
document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});
function reset() {
  ball.x = W / 2;
  ball.y = H / 2;
  ball.vx = 4 * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
  ball.vy = 3;
}
function loop() {
  if (up) player.y -= 5;
  if (down) player.y += 5;
  player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - player.h, player.y));

  ball.y += ball.vy;
  if (ball.y < ball.r || ball.y > H - ball.r) ball.vy *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 24 && ball.y > player.y && ball.y < player.y + player.h && ball.vx < 0) {
    ball.vx *= -1.05;
    score++;
  }
  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";

const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };

let down = false;

  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;
});

  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});

  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;

    score = 0;
    reset();

  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#db2777";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };

let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;

  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});

  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0d9488";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4f46e5";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();

const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 4, vy: 3, r: 8 };
let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;
});
document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});

  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);

  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";

  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";

}

const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };

let down = false;

  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0d9488";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#dc2626";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";

  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: #f5f5f7;

<canvas id="c" width="480" height="320"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 4, vy: 3, r: 8 };
let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;
});
document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});
function reset() {
  ball.x = W / 2;
  ball.y = H / 2;
  ball.vx = 4 * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
  ball.vy = 3;
}
function loop() {
  if (up) player.y -= 5;
  if (down) player.y += 5;
  player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - player.h, player.y));
  ai.y += (ball.y - (ai.y + ai.h / 2)) * 0.06;
  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;
  if (ball.y < ball.r || ball.y > H - ball.r) ball.vy *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 24 && ball.y > player.y && ball.y < player.y + player.h && ball.vx < 0) {
    ball.vx *= -1.05;
    score++;
  }
  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9333ea";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };

let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;
});
document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});

<style>
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;

    y: 40 + Math.random() * 220,
    vx: (6 + Math.random()) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1),

    r: 16,
    color: `hsl(${i * 60}, 80%, 55%)`,
  });

  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  for (const b of balls) {
    b.x += b.vx;
    b.y += b.vy;
    if (b.x < b.r || b.x > canvas.width - b.r) b.vx *= -1;
    if (b.y < b.r || b.y > canvas.height - b.r) b.vy *= -1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fill();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();

const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };

    ball.vx *= -1.05;
    score++;

  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9333ea";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ea580c";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };

let down = false;

  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});

    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#eab308";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 4, vy: 3, r: 8 };
let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;
});
document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});
function reset() {
  ball.x = W / 2;
  ball.y = H / 2;

  ball.vy = 3;

  if (down) player.y += 5;
  player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - player.h, player.y));

  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4f46e5";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);

  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);

  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";

}
